browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium, headless, 1440x1000, one browser context per identity

steps.action: Register step 1: open Entities; first view is Calendar; select List
steps.expected: Entities opens on Calendar; List shows the registry table.
steps.actual: Entities opened at /entities with the Compliance calendar heading. List moved to ?view=list and showed a table headed "Legal name Type Jurisdiction Registration no. Status Portal-listed Next obligation".

steps.action: Register step 2: Search entities by name, then Type/Status/Jurisdiction/Majority owner filters and Clear all
steps.expected: Search narrows by legal name; each filter exists and narrows; Clear all removes filters.
steps.actual: Search "Helix Software GmbH" left 1 row(s), all with that name. Type LLC plus Status Active left 8 of 27 rows, each LLC and Active. Clear all returned 27 rows and reset Type. Jurisdiction and Majority owner filters were present.

steps.action: Register steps 3-5: Add entity with identity details, Status default Active, Register, open the new Entity; creator Grant
steps.expected: Dialog titled Add entity; Status defaults to Active; Register saves the details; the adder holds a Grant.
steps.actual: The Add entity dialog opened with Status Active. Register saved "DOC-029r2 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings EGH2I" and the record opened with {"Formation jurisdiction":"Republic of Aldoria","Formed on":"2019-03-14","Registration no.":"ALD-EGH2I","Tax ID":"TX-EGH2I","Registered agent":"Aldoria Corporate Agents","Registered address":"1 Harbour Row, Port Aldo"} and Status Active. The record offered Manage access, and its access list named Nadia Haddad (["Nadia Haddad"]).

steps.action: Register step 5: change one field and move focus away; a selection saves when chosen; both survive reload; Status Dormant does not archive
steps.expected: Registered agent saves on blur; Status Dormant saves on selection; no Archived mark; Archive still offered.
steps.actual: After a reload Registered agent read "Aldoria Registered Agents Ltd" and Status read Dormant. The record still offered Archive and no Restore, so the Dormant Status did not archive it.

steps.action: Names are not unique: registering the same legal name again creates another Entity
steps.expected: A second Register with the same name creates a distinct record; the first is not changed.
steps.actual: Searching the name listed 2 rows linking to 2 different records: ["DOC-029r2 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings EGH2I Corporation Republic of Aldoria ALD-EGH2I Dormant No —","DOC-029r2 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings EGH2I LLC Duchy of Kessel — Active No —"]. The first kept Republic of Aldoria and Dormant.

steps.action: Negative: blank Legal name has a clear outcome
steps.expected: Register with no Legal name keeps the dialog open with the refusal message and creates nothing.
steps.actual: Register with an empty Legal name kept the dialog open and showed "Name the entity — its registered legal name.". The registry size stayed 2.

steps.action: Parties step 1: choose Our entity on a Contract; it survives reload
steps.expected: Our entity saves the chosen Entity.
steps.actual: C-32 Our entity read "DOC-029r2 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings EGH2I" after a reload.

steps.action: Parties steps 2-3: type a new name and Create; the first Counterparty is Primary
steps.expected: Create adds the new Counterparty to the Contract with the Primary mark.
steps.actual: Create "DOC-029r2 entities Cedar Supply L EGH2I" added it. After a reload the Contract showed 1 Primary mark and its parties were ["DOC-029r2 entities Cedar Supply L EGH2I"] with "DOC-029r2 entities Cedar Supply L EGH2I" primary.

steps.action: Parties step 4: add another Counterparty and Make primary
steps.expected: Make primary moves the Primary mark to the chosen Counterparty.
steps.actual: After Make primary and a reload the Contract's primary Counterparty was "DOC-029r2 entities Birch Logistics L EGH2I"; parties ["DOC-029r2 entities Birch Logistics L EGH2I","DOC-029r2 entities Cedar Supply L EGH2I"].

steps.action: Picker negatives: an exact existing name in another case offers no Create; a Counterparty on the Contract is not offered again
steps.expected: No Create row for a case variant; the attached party is not listed.
steps.actual: Typing "DOC-029R2 ENTITIES CEDAR SUPPLY L EGH2I" listed ["No counterparties to add."]: no Create row, and DOC-029r2 entities Cedar Supply L EGH2I (already on the Contract) was not offered.

steps.action: Parties step 5: Take name off the contract; next remaining takes Primary; shared record remains; final removal leaves none
steps.expected: Removing the Primary passes the mark; removal does not delete the shared Counterparty; removing the last leaves no Counterparties.
steps.actual: Taking DOC-029r2 entities Birch Logistics L EGH2I off left ["DOC-029r2 entities Cedar Supply L EGH2I"] with DOC-029r2 entities Cedar Supply L EGH2I Primary. Typing "DOC-029R2 ENTITIES BIRCH LOGISTICS L EGH2I" offered the shared record and no Create row (["DOC-029r2 entities Birch Logistics L EGH2I"]). Taking DOC-029r2 entities Cedar Supply L EGH2I off showed "Nobody is recorded on the other side yet.".

steps.action: Recovery: an archived Entity is not offered for a new selection; the existing Contract keeps its reference
steps.expected: Archive the chosen Entity; Our entity keeps showing it on C-n; another Contract does not offer it.
steps.actual: With the first "DOC-029r2 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings EGH2I" archived, C-32 still showed "DOC-029r2 entities C31 L Aldoria Holdings EGH2I" as Our entity. On C-33 Our entity offered 1 option with that name; its value was the live duplicate's ID, not the archived record's. The Entity was then restored.

steps.action: Officers steps 1-3: Directors & Officers, Add director or officer, name, Role, Appointed on, Linked user, Add
steps.expected: The Officer row saves name, role, date and linked user.
steps.actual: After Add and a reload the row read {"name":"Ines Castell L EGH2I","role":"Director","appointed":"2022-05-09","user":"Daniel Okafor"}.

steps.action: Officers step 4: correct text and move focus away; choose another role saves
steps.expected: Name edit saves on blur; Role selection saves at once.
steps.actual: The name saved as "Ines Castell L EGH2I Jr" on blur and was set back; Role Secretary saved on selection and read Secretary after a reload.

steps.action: Negative: a resignation date before the appointment date is refused
steps.expected: Refusal message; the appointment date is unchanged and no resignation is stored.
steps.actual: Resigned on 2021-01-01 showed "The resignation date cannot be before the appointment date.". After a reload Appointed on was 2022-05-09 and Resigned on was empty.

steps.action: Officers step 5: Resigned on retains a resignation; Show former reads former Officers; clearing the date returns the Officer
steps.expected: The resigned Officer leaves the current list, returns with Show former, and clearing the date restores it as current.
steps.actual: With Resigned on 2024-08-31 the Officer left the current list (0 rows). Show former showed it with 2024-08-31. Clearing the date and reloading returned it to the current list (1 row).

steps.action: Officer note: Linking a user does not grant that person Entity access
steps.expected: The linked user gains no Grant on the Entity.
steps.actual: The access list for the Entity named ["Nadia Haddad"]; the linked user Daniel Okafor held no Grant. (Access effect on a Confidential Entity is exercised in V-C53.)

steps.action: Officer note: Remove name deletes the Officer entry
steps.expected: The Officer is absent even with Show former.
steps.actual: After Remove Ines Castell L EGH2I and a reload, Show former listed no row for it.

steps.action: Registrations steps 1-3: Add registration with Jurisdiction, Registration number, Registered agent, Status Lapsed; Formation jurisdiction unchanged
steps.expected: The row saves; the Entity's Formation jurisdiction stays the same.
steps.actual: The Registration Nordvik L EGH2I saved {"number":"NV-EGH2I","agent":"Nordvik Agents AS","status":"Lapsed"}. Formation jurisdiction still read "Republic of Aldoria".

steps.action: Registrations step 3: edit text and move focus away; a Status selection saves immediately
steps.expected: Agent saves on blur; Withdrawn saves on selection.
steps.actual: After a reload Registered agent read "Nordvik Corporate Agents AS" and Status read Withdrawn.

steps.action: Registrations step 4 and note: Remove jurisdiction registration detaches linked Obligations and keeps them
steps.expected: The Obligation linked to the Registration remains with no Registration link.
steps.actual: An Obligation "DOC-029r2 entities C32 L licence renewal EGH2I" was linked to Nordvik L EGH2I. Remove Nordvik L EGH2I registration deleted the row; the Obligation stayed on the Entity with Registration "None".

steps.action: Holdings steps 1-4: Ownership tab, Add Holding, This Entity owns, Entity, Ownership percent, Add; Owners and Owned Entities on both records
steps.expected: Holding appears under Owned Entities on the owner and under Owners on the owned Entity.
steps.actual: DOC-029r2 entities C32 L main EGH2I listed DOC-029r2 entities C32 L owned EGH2I under Owned Entities; DOC-029r2 entities C32 L owned EGH2I listed DOC-029r2 entities C32 L main EGH2I under Owners at 60%.

steps.action: Holdings: Owns this Entity direction; over-100 total warns but saves; correcting the row on blur clears it
steps.expected: Second owner at 60% saves with 'Ownership totals 120% for name.'; changing a row to 40 saves and clears the warning.
steps.actual: Adding DOC-029r2 entities C32 L co-owner EGH2I as owner at 60% showed "Ownership totals 120% for DOC-029r2 entities C32 L owned EGH2I." and saved (60 after reload). Changing that row to 40 and moving focus saved 40 and no total warning remained.

steps.action: Negative: an out-of-range row percentage is refused without changing the saved value
steps.expected: 150 is refused; the row still reads 40 after reload.
steps.actual: Entering 150 showed "One or more request fields are invalid.". After a reload the row still read 40 and the other Holding still read 60.

steps.action: Holdings note: the Entity cannot own itself, duplicate a directional Holding, or create a loop
steps.expected: Self and existing related Entities are not offered; a loop is refused with a message.
steps.actual: On DOC-029r2 entities C32 L owned EGH2I the picker for "DOC-029r2 entities C32 L" offered ["DOC-029r2 entities C32 L third EGH2I"]: not itself and not DOC-029r2 entities C32 L main EGH2I, which already holds it. Adding DOC-029r2 entities C32 L third EGH2I as owner of DOC-029r2 entities C32 L main EGH2I (closing a loop through DOC-029r2 entities C32 L owned EGH2I) was refused with "This holding would create a loop: DOC-029r2 entities C32 L third EGH2I → DOC-029r2 entities C32 L main EGH2I → DOC-029r2 entities C32 L owned EGH2I → DOC-029r2 entities C32 L third EGH2I." and no Owner row was added.

steps.action: Holdings step 5: Remove name removes the Holding; neither Entity is deleted
steps.expected: The Holding leaves both records; both Entities still open.
steps.actual: After Remove DOC-029r2 entities C32 L co-owner EGH2I, Owners on DOC-029r2 entities C32 L owned EGH2I read "Owners DOC-029r2 entities C32 L main EGH2I %"; DOC-029r2 entities C32 L co-owner EGH2I still opened.

steps.action: Documents: a new Entity has no pre-created folders; Upload, Choose files, Kind Executed, Upload gives a v1 row
steps.expected: Empty Documents tab; the upload lands as v1 on this Entity only.
steps.actual: The Documents tab first showed "No documents on this Entity yet." with no folders. The upload produced the row "doc029-entities-certificate.txt kind Executed v1". DOC-029r2 entities C32 L owned EGH2I did not list it.

steps.action: Archive step 1: Archive saves immediately; Archived mark; editable controls unavailable
steps.expected: Archived mark and restore note; Legal name disabled; add buttons absent.
steps.actual: After Archive and a reload the record showed the Archived mark and "This entity is archived. Restore it to edit.". Legal name was disabled; Add director or officer, Add registration and Add obligation were absent.

steps.action: Archive: the archived Entity leaves ordinary registry and Holding picker results
steps.expected: Not in List search without Show archived; not offered in Add Holding.
steps.actual: The List search found 0 rows for the archived Entity, and Add Holding on DOC-029r2 entities C32 L co-owner EGH2I offered ["DOC-029r2 entities C32 L owned EGH2I","DOC-029r2 entities C32 L third EGH2I"], without it.

steps.action: Archive steps 2-3: List, Show archived, open the Entity, Restore; facts, relationships, Documents and Obligation remain; editing returns
steps.expected: Show archived lists it; Restore brings back editing with data intact.
steps.actual: With Show archived on, the List showed 1 row for it. Restore returned an editable Legal name and Add director or officer. Formation jurisdiction "Republic of Aldoria", the Holding of DOC-029r2 entities C32 L owned EGH2I, the uploaded Document, and the Obligation all remained.

steps.expected: Note saves on blur; Assignee Unassigned saves at once; both survive reload.

steps.expected: The Entity and Assignee filter stays in the address across each change.
steps.actual: Each change kept the filter: [["Month",true],["Previous month",true],["Next month",true],["Today",true],["Due-date list",true]]; the list again showed 2 rows.

steps.action: Calendar step 2: From/To narrow by date; Include completed exists
steps.expected: From 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30 leaves only the one-off.

steps.action: V-C53 A: a Grant gives the named person access
steps.expected: Priya opens the Confidential Entity.
steps.actual: Priya Raman opened DOC-029r2 entities C53 A secret sub EGH2I.

steps.action: V-C53 A: without a Grant, a Legal Team Member cannot reach the Confidential Entity; Holding shows Restricted Entity; chart shows Confidential Entity; no self-grant
steps.expected: Direct open fails; parent's Owned Entities shows Restricted Entity without a link; chart node reads Confidential Entity with no link; self-grant refused.
steps.actual: Nadia Haddad: opening DOC-029r2 entities C53 A secret sub EGH2I showed no record (API 404). DOC-029r2 entities C53 A parent EGH2I's Owned Entities read "Owned Entities DOC-029r2 entities C53 A plural sub EGH2I % Restricted Entity" with no link to it. The chart drew 1 node(s) labelled "Confidential Entity" with no link and no legal name. A List search for its name found 0 rows. A self-grant request returned 404 "No entity exists with this id.".

steps.action: V-C53 A: an Officer user link and a linked Contract do not grant access
steps.expected: After being linked as an Officer, the user still cannot open the Entity; a reachable Contract signed by it shows Restricted Entity.
steps.actual: With Nadia Haddad linked as an Officer on DOC-029r2 entities C53 A secret sub EGH2I, reading the Entity still returned 404. On C-41, whose Our entity is DOC-029r2 entities C53 A secret sub EGH2I, Nadia Haddad saw "Restricted Entity" and the legal name appeared 0 times.

steps.action: Grant step 5: Remove name withdraws access; the relationship is preserved
steps.expected: Priya leaves the list, cannot open the Entity, and sees Restricted Entity for the Holding; the actor still sees the Holding.
steps.actual: After Remove Priya Raman the list read ["Daniel Okafor"]. Priya's read of DOC-029r2 entities C53 A secret sub EGH2I returned 404, and DOC-029r2 entities C53 A parent EGH2I's Owned Entities showed her "Owned Entities DOC-029r2 entities C53 A plural sub EGH2I % Restricted Entity". Daniel Okafor still saw "Owned Entities DOC-029r2 entities C53 A plural sub EGH2I % DOC-029r2 entities C53 A secret sub EGH2I %".

steps.action: Negative: removing the last live person from a Confidential Entity is refused
steps.expected: Remove self as the only grantee shows the refusal and keeps the Grant.
steps.actual: Removing Daniel Okafor, the only person in the list, showed "Grant another person access before removing the last person from a confidential entity." and the Grant stayed.

steps.action: Turning the Confidential switch off makes the Entity available to all Legal Team Members and Administrators without Grants
steps.expected: The other role and Priya can open the Entity again.
steps.actual: With the switch off after a reload, Nadia Haddad opened DOC-029r2 entities C53 A secret sub EGH2I in the browser and reads returned 200 for Nadia Haddad and 200 for Priya Raman, none holding a Grant.

steps.action: Negative: turning on Confidential with no live person in the list is refused
steps.expected: After the Administrator removes the only Grant on an open Entity, the switch refuses with a message.
steps.actual: With "No grants yet." in Confidential access, turning on the switch showed "Grant at least one person access before making this entity confidential." and after a reload the Entity was still open.
